# `court_opinion_bodies`

**Individual court opinion text variants**

Individual opinion metadata and all eight supported native text variants from CourtListener bulk opinions. opinion_id is the primary/dedup key; cluster_id joins court_opinion_clusters.cluster_id to obtain decision, docket and court context. Opinion types remain literal source values. Version 2 preserves NULL and empty strings separately in text variants; metadata empty strings become NULL. All columns are VARCHAR.

**Coverage.** Sampled. Scheduled builds default to 250,000 opinions in dump order, not a random sample, date window or complete court population. The retained older 250,000-row output has the former 19-column representation; the corrected 25-column replay has only 284 rows. A wider corrected rebuild remains required. See docs/research/local-data-reuse-2026-09-21.md. Neither local count establishes current publication or cluster completeness. *(measured 2026-09-21)*

**Data quality.** Several text variants can represent the same opinion and must not be counted as different decisions. Text may contain source markup or OCR errors. Presence of text does not establish completeness or accuracy. Old 19-column outputs need explicit rebuilding; they are not silently admitted as the current representation. dump_date identifies the selected release date, not a file digest or proof that later corrections were read.

- **Parquet file:** `court_opinion_bodies.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `opinion_id` | `VARCHAR` | CourtListener individual opinion ID. Primary/dedup key, distinct from the parent cluster_id. |
| `cluster_id` | `VARCHAR` | Parent CourtListener decision-cluster ID; many opinions may join one court_opinion_clusters row. |
| `opinion_type` | `VARCHAR` | Literal source opinion type code, such as majority, concurrence or dissent categories; not a resolved person or decision identifier. |
| `author_str` | `VARCHAR` | Source author text; not normalized to a person identity. |
| `author_id` | `VARCHAR` | CourtListener author ID when supplied; separate from author_str and retained as a string. |
| `joined_by_str` | `VARCHAR` | Source text identifying judges joining the opinion; not a structured relationship table. |
| `per_curiam` | `VARCHAR` | Source per-curiam flag, stored as a string. |
| `sha1` | `VARCHAR` | Source-provided SHA-1 value; not a SpicyRegs capture digest or independently verified byte pin. |
| `page_count` | `VARCHAR` | Source page count, stored as a string; may be unavailable. |
| `download_url` | `VARCHAR` | Source original-document URL when supplied; no current accessibility claim. |
| `local_path` | `VARCHAR` | Path reported by CourtListener, not a path to a retained SpicyRegs file. |
| `extracted_by_ocr` | `VARCHAR` | Source OCR flag, stored as a string; it does not establish extraction quality. |
| `plain_text` | `VARCHAR` | Literal source plain_text variant, preserving NULL versus empty string. |
| `html_with_citations` | `VARCHAR` | Literal source HTML-with-citations variant, preserving NULL versus empty string and original markup. |
| `available_text_fields` | `VARCHAR` | Comma-separated names of nonempty supported text variants, or NULL if none. Empty string variants remain in their own columns. |
| `text_char_count` | `VARCHAR` | Length of the longest nonempty supported text variant, stored as a string. It is not a sum, token count or completeness score. |
| `date_created` | `VARCHAR` | Source opinion-record creation timestamp when supplied. |
| `date_modified` | `VARCHAR` | Source opinion-record modification timestamp when supplied. |
| `dump_date` | `VARCHAR` | Selected CourtListener dump date in ISO form; may be NULL for a local input without a supplied release date. |
| `html` | `VARCHAR` | Literal source html variant, preserving NULL versus empty string and original markup. |
| `html_lawbox` | `VARCHAR` | Literal source html_lawbox variant, preserving NULL versus empty string and original markup. |
| `html_columbia` | `VARCHAR` | Literal source html_columbia variant, preserving NULL versus empty string and original markup. |
| `html_anon_2020` | `VARCHAR` | Literal source html_anon_2020 variant, preserving NULL versus empty string and original markup. |
| `xml_harvard` | `VARCHAR` | Literal source xml_harvard variant, preserving NULL versus empty string and original markup. |
| `xml_scan` | `VARCHAR` | Literal source xml_scan variant, preserving NULL versus empty string and original markup. |
